_comment: Curated leaderboard references for tdcommons datasets. PRECEDENCE per dataset: (1) TDC's own ADMET Benchmark Group leaderboard (tdcommons.ai), 'provider': 'tdc' -- these 13 entries were previously mislabeled 'provider': 'polaris' on the (incorrect) assumption that Polaris Hub mirrors this leaderboard; verified 2026-08-06 by reading tdcommons.ai's own per-dataset leaderboard pages directly -- none of these model names (ZairaChem, MapLight, MiniMol, CFA, ADMETrix, ...) appear among Polaris Hub's own submitted results for the matching benchmark, which is a separate, differently-populated leaderboard (see scripts/polaris_leaderboard.json, maintained by fetch_polaris_leaderboard.py, for that one); (2) MoleculeNet, where the dataset is the same as a MoleculeNet benchmark (hiv, clintox); (3) a single reputable/recent paper ('provider': 'literature') for datasets on no leaderboard at all. 'provider' records which of these each score came from. IMPORTANT: 'literature' entries are best-effort REFERENCES from individual papers on THAT paper's own split/metric (recorded in 'split'/'source') -- they are NOT comparable to one another, to the TDC numbers, or to eosbench's baseline. Datasets still blank have no clean dataset-specific number (the Butkiewicz HTS panel is reported as logAUC, not ROC-AUC; SARS-CoV-2, PAMPA, skin_reaction, carcinogens have no comparable AUROC). 'std' (optional) is the reported cross-seed standard deviation, where known -- for the 'tdc'-provider entries this is the std across the ADMET Benchmark Group's required 5 seeds ([1,2,3,4,5], per tdcommons.ai's own submission guide: 5 independent training runs on different seeded train/valid splits, scored on the SAME frozen test set each time, then averaged). 'comparable' records whether eosbench's own single-run scaffold-holdout result (train once on train, score once on test) is a fair comparison to THIS score: 'yes' = same physical test set AND a single-run statistic on both sides; 'split_only' = same physical test set, but this score is itself a multi-run average (so it's a different *kind* of number, not just a different draw); 'no' = a different test set/split entirely (cross-filled from another dataset's own copy, or a paper's own ad hoc split); 'unverified' = not independently checked either way. 'split' is normalized to exactly one of 'scaffold' / 'random' / 'external' -- 'external' means evaluated on a genuinely different validation set (different molecules entirely, not a partition of this dataset), used only by 'literature' entries so far; any paper-specific detail (which split, which test set) lives in 'source' instead, since 'provider': 'literature' already flags it as a one-off, not-cross-comparable reference. Keyed by tdcommons dataset slug.

hiv.source: Wu et al. 2018 (MoleculeNet), best model; same dataset as TDC HIV

clintox.source: Wu et al. 2018 (MoleculeNet), best model (2-task avg); same dataset as TDC ClinTox

b3db_classification.source: B3DB / B3clf best model (Meng et al., Sci. Data 2021)

herg_karim.source: recent ML benchmarks on the Karim et al. 2021 hERG set (~0.94-0.96)
